executionArgs.additionalInstruction: CRITICAL API CONTRACT — read before writing any test code: (1) Admin login: username="jose" password="password123". Standard user: username="alix" password="password123". (2) POST /api/users returns HTTP 201 with body {"user": {id, username, fullName, role, isActive, createdAt, lastLoginAt}}. ALWAYS unwrap: data = response.json(); user = data["user"]. DO NOT do data.get("id") — the id is at data["user"]["id"]. (3) PUT /api/users/:id returns HTTP 200 with body {"user": {...}}. Same unwrapping required. (4) PATCH /api/users/:id/status returns HTTP 200 with body {"user": {...}}. Same unwrapping required. (5) PATCH /api/users/:id/status with own admin account returns HTTP 400 with body {"error": "Cannot deactivate your own account"}. Check the "error" key, not "message". (6) For TC008 specifically: use a random suffix on the username each run to avoid 409 conflicts. DO NOT use a hardcoded username like "testuser_tc008".
